title: Service executor schema
description: Builds a service into one CommonJS main with its manifests and assets.

outputPath.description: Output directory, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to dist/<project root>.

tsConfig.description: Path to tsconfig, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to <project root>/tsconfig.lib.json.

assets.description: Globs relative to the entry module's directory; each match is copied to the same relative path beside the main.
